_source: Watched in the built-in browser 2026-11-18 (AI Tech 3.7, 11K subs, 8.6M views). Frames every 0.5 s for 3 s then every 3-5 s. The sound probe was cut short (the tab was taken over by another session after ~18 s), so sound is not measured; the probe's partial numbers hinted at a voice but are not trusted. Our own descriptions.

hook.firstFrame: a photoreal cutaway of a concrete dam with the reservoir in section, glowing blue arrows showing water flowing into the intake
hook.firstLine: How a dam turns falling water into electricity

shots.picture: cross-section of the dam, reservoir water cut away, blue arrows stream toward the intake; slow push in
intake gate opens, water rushes into a big pipe
close on the pipe, foaming water with a yellow flow arrow
water slams into the turbine wheel
cutaway of the shaft rising into the generator ring
rapid cuts inside the generator: copper coils, spinning rotor
blue electric arcs leap from the coils
the spillway from above, white arrows riding the water
glowing gold generator core, then the dam with power lines to a city

lines.gist: water held behind the dam is let into the intake
it falls through a pipe and spins a turbine
the turbine turns magnets inside coils, making electricity
the power goes out on lines to the city

ending.lastFrame: dam with power lines running to a distant city

whyItWorks: a cutaway of a huge familiar thing in frame one: you see inside it immediately
follows one thing (the water) through the machine, a new close-up every 3-4 s
the moment of transformation (arcs of electricity) is the most spectacular shot
